summary: Selected papers emphasize perturbative jet-quenching theory, BMS evolution, color coherence, saturation analogies, inhomogeneous magnetic-field QCD phases, finite-momentum chiral instabilities, p-O charged-particle production, conditional-diffusion inference for TMDs, sparse-autoencoder interpretability for neutrino foundation models, differentiable event generators, and differentiable likelihood minimization.
strongest_paper: 2608.25984 and 2608.25983: a paired framework connecting color coherence, BMS evolution, jet quenching, and saturation-like nonlinear dynamics.

papers.title: Color Coherence and the Soft Structure of QCD Jets in Vacuum and the QGP
papers.abstract: Perturbative framework for soft jet evolution in vacuum and QGP using BMS evolution of Wilson-line correlators; medium effects modify boundary conditions while preserving ultraviolet structure.

papers.title: Chiral soliton lattice in inhomogeneous magnetic fields
papers.abstract: Low-energy QCD effective theory study of whether chiral soliton lattice states persist in nonuniform magnetic fields relevant to heavy-ion collisions and neutron stars.

papers.title: Robust Finite-Momentum Instabilities in Dense Matter
papers.authors: Andre G. da Silva, Ricardo L. S. Farias, Theo Motta, William R. Tavares
papers.abstract: Shows that regulator dependence of inhomogeneous chiral instability regions in the NJL model is largely removed when regulators act only on divergent vacuum terms.

papers.title: Jet Quenching Meets Gluon Saturation
papers.authors: Paul Caucal, Kevin Eisenberg, Yacine Mehtar-Tani
papers.abstract: Applies BMS evolution and a saturation analogy to jet fragmentation in heavy-ion collisions and computes a proof-of-principle jet nuclear modification factor.

papers.title: Particle production in p-O collisions at LHC energy
papers.abstract: Compares three-source relativistic diffusion predictions for p-O charged-hadron production with preliminary ALICE Run 3 data and retunes model parameters.

papers.title: Learning Transverse Momentum Distributions from Raw Scattering Events via Conditional Diffusion
papers.authors: Jitao Xu, Christopher Cocuzza, Kevin Braga, Daniel Lersch, Nobuo Sato, Yaohang Li
papers.abstract: Conditional diffusion model maps raw SIDIS event kinematics to TMD PDFs with uncertainty estimates in simulated CLAS12-like studies.

papers.title: Finding and using interpretable latents in a neutrino foundation model with sparse autoencoders
papers.authors: Raphael Bonnet-Guerrini, Johann Ioannou-Nikolaides, Inar Timiryasov, Vincenzo Piuri
papers.abstract: Sparse-autoencoder interpretability study of an IceCube neutrino foundation model, validated with held-out tests, nuisance controls, replicated dictionaries, and causal interventions.

papers.title: ADoNIS: A Differentiable generatOr of Neutrino Interaction Samples
papers.abstract: Differentiable neutrino event generator propagates exact derivatives through nuclear ground state, hard scattering, and intranuclear cascade components while matching ACHILLES-style predictions.

papers.title: Efficient binned profile likelihood minimization for precision measurements with RABBIT
papers.authors: David Walter, Josh Bendavid, Kenneth Long
papers.abstract: TensorFlow-based differentiable programming framework for large binned profile likelihood minimization using exact gradients, Hessian-vector products, and trust-region Krylov methods.

papers.title: Classical and Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning for Trigger-Like Event Selection on CMS Open Data
papers.authors: Tariq Mahmood, Muhammad Awais Rafique, Talab Hussain, Juan Pablo Perez Aguilar, Alfredo Raya, Muhammad Ahsan
papers.abstract: Compares classical and simulated eight-qubit hybrid quantum classifiers on a CMS-open-data trigger-like task; classical ANN performance remains best and the authors frame the study as a controlled reference rather than quantum advantage.
